blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine government’s debt climbed to a record P19.61 trillion in August, nearing its full-year target as continued borrowing and a weaker peso pushed it higher. On Wednesday, the Bureau of Treasury said total outstanding debt rose 1.12 percent from the previous month.
